notes.title: Presenter Slides™ - Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
Greetings, [b]Presenter![/b]
We would like to announce a small software update.

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed typos
[*] Fixed lighthouse entry conditions
[*] Fixed a stuck-in-animation bug
[*] Updated map layout
[*] Adjusted voice lines
[/list]
[b]License Exclusive Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Watermark is now properly removed for legit customers
[/list]
We would also like to remind our trusted consumers that there are no more bugs to be found! 
[i]But in the unlikely case that one is found, it can be reported at [url=presenterslides2000@yahoo.com]presenterslides2000@yahoo.com[/url] [/i]
